name: United Nations
summary:
The United Nations’ site is un.org. The emblem in the tab is the icon news and document bookmarks use, measured from the file that host returned.

Checked 12 November 2026 against un.org. HTML came from https://www.un.org/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: shortcut icon → https://www.un.org/sites/un2.un.org/themes/bootstrap_un2/favicon.ico.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.un.org/sites/un2.un.org/themes/bootstrap_un2/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 318 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

The only measured sizes are inside favicon.ico: 16×16.
